preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2 * 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value a_i is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(sum(dist(i, v) * a[i] for i in range(1, n + 1)) for v in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible cost of the tree, where the cost is defined as the sum over all vertices i of (distance from i to v multiplied by a_i), and v is chosen optimally.
